relations.support_notes: The colophon reports "dge 'dun dpal bzang zhes bya'i rtog ge pas bsgrigs pa'i dge 'dis..." - dGe 'dun dpal bzang could be the author or the compiler of someone else's teaching. He might also be the scribe - compare with the use of the verb "grigs" for the scribe on the cover page of (ID:4894) ("bris" in the colophon).

comments:
Incomplete commentary on the Abhisamayālaṃkāra­ (ID:3706). Features abundant use of "chos can...thal/te...phyir" arguments, including also the use of the pronoun "khyod" as a variable.
Although the manuscript was grouped with works by rNgog Blo ldan shes rab (ID:3786) in [XCKNA9JH], rNgog Blo ldan shes rab does not appear to have been the author. In particular, the above-mentioned features are not found in other works of rNgog Blo ldan shes rab.
Discussed in [DQZ4IIQZ]: 59 (170) and 76-78 (151-153).
